name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo has been involved in motorsport for over 25 years, although his journey began in the world of human resources for a large manufacturing company. A lifelong racing enthusiast, he volunteered at local rallies and races in his youth, eventually leveraging his HR experience to assist smaller racing teams with their staffing and organizational needs. He quickly discovered a passion for matching the right talent to the right roles within the high-pressure environment of motorsport.

Ricardo believes in fostering a supportive and inclusive team environment where every member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. He is a strong advocate for continuous learning and development, and works tirelessly to identify and nurture potential within the team. While he is always professional, Ricardo is known for his calming presence and ability to mediate conflicts effectively.

What sets Ricardo apart is his meticulous approach to talent management. He uses innovative strategies to attract top talent and ensure that the team has the right mix of skills and experience to succeed. His dedication to employee well-being and professional growth has made him a highly respected figure within the Sprint Masters organization.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium height with a sturdy build and kind eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn copy of the Chilean labor code.
Insists on starting every Monday with a team-building activity, even if it's just a quick trivia game.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses when delivering good news.
